mapper.select: SELECT tm.task_id, tm.athlete_id, tm.status, a.name AS ath_name, a.gender AS ath_gender, d.dept_name AS ath_team FROM apms_task_member tm LEFT JOIN apms_athlete a ON tm.athlete_id = a.athlete_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON a.primary_team_id = d.dept_id WHERE tm.task_id = #{taskId} ORDER BY a.name ASC, tm.athlete_id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM apms_task_member WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND status = #{status}
mapper.update: UPDATE apms_task_member SET status = #{status} WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND athlete_id = #{athleteId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apms_task_member WHERE task_id = #{taskId} AND athlete_id = #{athleteId}
